name: ADS1115 12/16-bit ADC Breakout
description: PCB for the Adafruit 12 and 16 bit I2C ADC with Programmable Gain Amplifier. The ADS1115 is a precision analog-to-digital converter with up to 16-bit resolution and programmable gain amplifier. Works with both 3.3V and 5V microcontrollers.

name: TCS34725 Color Sensor Breakout
description: RGB and Clear light sensing color sensor with 3,800,000:1 dynamic range, integrated IR blocking filter for accurate color measurement, and adjustable integration time and gain. Perfect for color detection and light sensing projects.

name: MPR121 12-Channel Capacitive Touch Sensor
description: I2C-based capacitive touch sensor with 12 independent touch pad inputs. Features built-in filtering, selectable I2C address for up to 48 pads on one bus. Includes IRQ line indicator LED. 3V-only chip with regulated power and I2C level shifting for 3-5V compatibility.

name: BMP180 Barometric Pressure Sensor
description: Precision barometric pressure and temperature sensor with altitude measurement capability. Offers temperature accuracy of plus or minus 1C and pressure accuracy of plus or minus 1 hPa for altitude measurement within plus or minus 1 meter. 5V-safe with integrated regulator and I2C level shifter.

name: LSM303 Compass + Accelerometer
description: Triple-axis accelerometer and magnetometer compass module on single chip. Measures gravity direction for orientation sensing and magnetic field for true north detection. I2C interface with 5V-safe logic and power, 3.3V regulator included.

name: ALS-PT19 Analog Light Sensor
description: Wide spectrum analog light sensor with logarithmic response. Measures ambient light levels accurately across a wide dynamic range. Simple analog interface for integration with any microcontroller ADC.

name: METRO 328 Development Board
description: Full-featured Arduino-compatible development board built on ATmega328. Includes USB-to-serial converter, polarity-protected DC power jack, four status LEDs for debugging, and hardware SPI/I2C/UART support. Works with all Arduino shields.

name: Trinket 3.3/5V Mini Microcontroller
description: Ultra-compact ATtiny85-based development board. Available in 3.3V and 5V logic versions. Arduino IDE programmable with bitbang USB support. Tiny enough to embed directly in projects with minimal cost and size penalty.

name: BME680 Air Quality Sensor
description: All-in-one environmental sensor from Bosch with temperature, humidity, barometric pressure, and VOC gas sensing. Measures temperature to plus or minus 1C, humidity to plus or minus 3 percent, pressure to plus or minus 1 hPa. SPI and I2C interfaces with 3.3V regulator and level shifting.

name: DS3231 Precision Real-Time Clock
description: Extremely accurate RTC with integrated temperature-compensated crystal oscillator. Maintains time to within 2 minutes per year. Includes battery-backed power and temperature sensor for frequency compensation. Perfect for precision timekeeping and data logging.

name: MAX31865 RTD Temperature Amplifier
description: Precision temperature sensor amplifier for PT100 resistance temperature detectors. Supports 2, 3, or 4-wire RTD configuration with automatic wire resistance compensation. Provides laboratory-grade temperature measurement accuracy for industrial applications.

name: MAX31856 Thermocouple Amplifier
description: Precision thermocouple amplifier with cold junction compensation. Supports all common thermocouple types with automatic type detection. SPI interface with microcontroller for high-precision temperature measurement in harsh environments.

name: IS31FL3731 16x9 LED Matrix Driver
description: PWM LED driver for 16x9 LED matrices with individual brightness control. I2C interface with 8 frames of display memory for animations. Chainable design - stack up to 4 drivers for 16x36 displays. STEMMA QT connectors for solderless connections.

name: RA8875 TFT Display Driver
description: Hardware-accelerated TFT display controller for 40-pin parallel TFT displays up to 800x480. Includes resistive touchscreen support over same SPI interface. 768KB on-chip RAM for display buffering, hardware shape drawing, and built-in fonts.

name: 16-Channel PWM Servo Driver
description: I2C-controlled 16-channel PWM driver for servo and LED control. Up to 62 boards chainable for 992 total outputs. 12-bit resolution, adjustable frequency, open-drain or push-pull output. Reverse polarity protection and 220 ohm series resistors on outputs.

name: PAM8302 Mono Audio Amplifier
description: Class-D mono amplifier delivering 2.5W into 4-8 ohm speakers. 2.0-5.5V supply range with 90 percent efficiency. Volume adjustable via trimmer pot. Built-in thermal and over-current protection. Fully differential inputs for clean audio without ground issues.

name: FT232H Multi-Protocol USB Breakout
description: Swiss-army-knife USB breakout for SPI, I2C, serial UART, JTAG protocols. Built-in GPIO pins for LED control and button reading. Direct computer-to-device communication without intermediate microcontroller. Perfect for development and debugging.

name: 4-Channel BSS138 Level Shifter
description: Bidirectional voltage level shifter for 4 channels. Convert between 3.3V and 5V logic levels safely. BSS138 MOSFET-based design for reliable operation. Essential for connecting 3.3V sensors to 5V microcontrollers.

name: Feather M0 Express SAMD21
description: CircuitPython-focused 48MHz ARM Cortex M0+ development board. 256KB Flash, 32KB RAM. Built-in USB bootloader, 2MB SPI Flash, NeoPixel LED. Battery charger for LiPo batteries. Works with entire FeatherWing ecosystem.

name: Feather M4 Express SAMD51
description: Fast 120MHz ARM Cortex M4 with floating-point support. 512KB Flash, 192KB RAM. Originally designed for CircuitPython but Arduino compatible. Runs code at significantly faster speeds than M0-based boards.

name: QT Py SAMD21 Tiny Development Board
description: Ultra-small SAMD21-based board with STEMMA QT I2C connector for plug-and-play sensors. Seeed Xiao-compatible pinout. 256KB Flash, 32KB RAM. RGB NeoPixel, reset button. Optional SOIC SPI Flash on bottom pads.

name: QT Py RP2040 Dual-Core Board
description: Tiny RP2040 board with STEMMA QT I2C connector. Dual-core 125MHz processor, 264KB RAM, 8MB SPI Flash. RGB NeoPixel, boot and reset buttons. Same form-factor as SAMD21 QT Py. CircuitPython and MicroPython support.

name: KB2040 RP2040 Keyboard Controller
description: Pro Micro-shaped RP2040 board for custom keyboard builds. 8MB QSPI Flash, built-in NeoPixel. STEMMA QT I2C port. Castellated pads for direct PCB mounting. 20 GPIO pins support up to 100-key matrices. CircuitPython ready.

name: Feather ESP32-S2 WiFi Board
description: Low-power WiFi Feather with native USB support. 4MB Flash, 2MB PSRAM. Built-in LiPo charger. STEMMA QT connector for sensors. Single-core 240MHz processor ideal for IoT and WiFi projects.

name: Feather 328P Classic Arduino
description: Nostalgic ATmega328P-based Feather at 3.3V and 8MHz. Familiar Arduino chip in Feather form factor with USB-serial converter via CP2104. Battery charging support. Compatible with entire FeatherWing ecosystem.

name: Feather STM32F405 Express
description: Fastest CircuitPython-capable Feather at 168MHz STM32F405 Cortex M4 with FPU. 1MB Flash, 192KB RAM, 2MB SPI Flash. USB-C connector, SD card socket, NeoPixel. First USB-C Feather design.

name: ESP32 HUZZAH Breakout
description: Minimal ESP32 breakout for size and cost-conscious projects. Dual-core WiFi/Bluetooth processor with 4MB SPI Flash. Requires external CP2104 or FTDI cable for programming. Perfect for battery-powered IoT applications.

name: ESP32-S3 TFT Feather with Display
description: ESP32-S3 Feather with integrated 240x135 IPS TFT color display. Native USB, 4MB Flash, 2MB PSRAM. PWM-controlled backlight. STEMMA QT connector. Deep sleep mode uses only 100uA. Perfect for portable GUI applications.

name: Feather RP2350 Dual-Core
description: Latest Feather with powerful RP2350 dual-core processor. 8MB QSPI Flash, STEMMA QT connector, NeoPixel. Boot and reset buttons. Works with CircuitPython and MicroPython. Future-proof design with latest RP silicon.

name: MAX4466 Electret Microphone Amplifier
description: Low-noise microphone amplifier with integrated 20-20kHz electret microphone. Selectable 25x to 125x gain via trimmer pot. Excellent power supply noise rejection. Rail-to-rail output for maximum ADC range. Perfect for voice changers and audio-reactive projects.
